roles.responsibility: Approve site use and public operation
Own daily service, takeover, maintenance, and exit
Verify calibration, data lineage, and failure records
Review notices, equity, and health-language limits

gates.test: Walk every active scenario without a phone, account, or live sensor and record the staffed alternative.
gates.pass_rule: 12/12 scenario records identify a usable non-digital equivalent before activation.
gates.stop_rule: Any active scenario without an equivalent service returns to staffed-only operation.

gates.test: Review the data dictionary, sample payloads, retention, and deletion path for every active sensor.
gates.pass_rule: Zero unauthorized personal identifiers in the reviewed pilot payloads.
gates.stop_rule: An unauthorized identifier or untraceable field stops collection and triggers review.
gates.evidence: data dictionary and payload review log

gates.test: Stage an anomaly for every active scenario and record the responsible person's takeover action.
gates.pass_rule: Every active scenario completes a documented takeover drill before public operation.
gates.stop_rule: A failed or unowned takeover drill keeps automatic advice off.

gates.test: Complete a staffed origin-to-service-to-exit journey in each of the three pilot lungs.
gates.pass_rule: No unresolved accessibility blocker remains on an activated pilot journey.
gates.stop_rule: A blocked journey disables the associated digital guidance and routes service to staff.
gates.evidence: three-lung accessibility walk-through and defect log

gates.test: Check device ID, precision, calibration time, retention, operator, and public notice.
gates.pass_rule: 100% of active pilot devices have complete registry fields and a visible notice.
gates.stop_rule: An unregistered or overdue device produces no public advice.
gates.evidence: device register and calibration certificate index

gates.test: Assign an operator, maintenance window, consumable list, removal path, and quoted cost heading.
gates.pass_rule: Every activated unit has a named authorized operator and an approved, withdrawable cost envelope.
gates.stop_rule: An ownerless or unfunded unit does not activate or expand.
gates.evidence: operator sign-off, quantity sheet, and local quotes

decision_rule.expand: All applicable gates pass and field-performance evidence supports public value.
decision_rule.hold_local: Safety gates pass but performance, workload, or affordability remains uncertain.
decision_rule.exit: A stop rule persists, public value is not evidenced, or operation lacks authorization or funding.

precision_notice: This contract makes evidence requirements explicit. It does not prove approval, field performance, affordability, or implementation commitment.
